input_contract.source: Exact original native A/B decimal literals, conversion performed in each actual scalar type; complex inputs are purely imaginary.
input_contract.library: System libcublas.so.12.0.2.224 pinned all4models, matching cublas[SCDZ]gelsBatched ABI
input_contract.timing: One library call pertype, sum4calls; reset/H2D/pointer-array allocation/handle setup outside timer. Five outertrials, firstdiscarded.
input_contract.tolerances: Per-type solution-to-one complex modulus<1e-6 FP32/<1e-8 FP64; direct cross-model components stricter1e-8 alltypes.
input_contract.scope: Only original square5x5 batch2 systems, not overdetermined least-squares or a framework-authored solver. Library interoperability,0authoredkernels.
input_contract.output: Complete10solutions/type, real+imag components plus host status/info. OriginalNULLper-batch info buffer retained.

cuda.native_check_description: Every complex solution checked by full modulus at source per-type bounds, stricter than native cancellation-prone residual projection.

cuda_jl.native_check_description: Every complex solution under source precision bounds and exact-rational actual-input oracle; raw pinned vendor ABI.

ka.native_check_description: KA allocation, same pinned cuBLAS vendor ABI; full complex solution and independent exact-input oracle.

measurement_correction.reason: Raw cuBLAS handle defaults to legacy stream0; no-argument CUDA.synchronize waits task-local stream, not necessarily vendor work. Correct every boundary to context-wide CUDA.synchronize(CUDA.context()), matching cudaDeviceSynchronize.
